picks.matchup: North Carolina Tar Heels @ TCU Horned Frogs
picks.title: North Carolina Tar Heels +8.5
picks.title_full: North Carolina Tar Heels +8.5, full game, -108
picks.rationale: The ratings model has this at 4.9 on a neutral field in Dublin and the market has moved the other way, from 7.5 to 8.5 with the moneyline going 330 to 360, which is the market telling me the carryover ratings are stale. Search results describe North Carolina arriving without its defensive coordinator, who is on medical leave, and without its general manager, who is on administrative leave, but I could not open those pages to confirm the wording, so I am not treating either as established and I am keeping this well below the publish line. A second year program that turned over most of its roster is exactly where last season's numbers lie to you. I am wrong if the 3.6 points the model sees are real and the off field news is noise, which is the case for taking the points here.

picks.matchup: San Jose State Spartans @ USC Trojans
picks.title: San Jose State Spartans +38.5
picks.title_full: San Jose State Spartans +38.5, full game, -104
picks.rationale: The model wants 35.4 and the market is laying 38.5, so there are 3.1 points here, and San Jose State starts an experienced quarterback in Luke Weaver rather than the walk on a number this size usually implies. Numbers above four touchdowns are also where a favourite's own clock management does the covering, and USC has no reason to chase points in the fourth quarter of an opener. What keeps it a shadow pick is that I found no researched reason the market is wrong, only the rating gap, and the gap alone is what the 7.5 cap exists to refuse. I am wrong if USC treats this as a statement game and the reserves keep scoring.

picks.matchup: NC State Wolfpack @ Virginia Cavaliers
picks.title: NC State Wolfpack +4.5
picks.rationale: Virginia's first ACC availability report of the season lists 16 players out, and four of them are wide receivers, including Rico Flores, the projected top target, who spent training camp on a hamstring. The same report takes out the placekicker, which is worth real points in a game the market prices inside five, and NC State comes the other way returning CJ Bailey. make_slate found no candidate here, so the ratings model agrees with the market inside 1.5 points and this pick rests entirely on the report. Against that, the number has already moved from 5.5 to 4.5 and the moneyline from 220 to 178 since Wednesday, and the hook costs 115, so most of the news is in the price. I am wrong if that point the market already gave back was the whole edge and Virginia's remaining receivers hold up.

sources.claim: Virginia has 16 players ruled out for this game on the first ACC availability report.
sources.quote: Wednesday's initial ACC weekly injury report listed 16 Cavaliers as out against the Wolfpack.

sources.claim: Virginia's projected number one receiver is out with a hamstring problem carried through camp.
sources.quote: Most notable is Flores, a transfer from UCLA, who dealt with hamstring issues during training camp.

sources.claim: NC State returns its starting quarterback.
sources.quote: NC State's roster has also gone through many changes, but they return one of the ACC's best quarterbacks in CJ Bailey.

picks.matchup: Jacksonville State Gamecocks @ North Dakota State Bison
picks.title: Over 46.5
picks.rationale: The model has this 9.5 points over the market, which would be the second largest edge on the board, and the Fargodome removes weather from the question. Against that, North Dakota State is replacing both its starting quarterback and its lead running back in its first FBS season, and a 46.5 total between two teams that won at this level by playing defence and shortening games looks like the market pricing something the ratings cannot see. I am logging the model's side at 6.0 rather than taking it, because I think the honest read here is the Under and I do not have the research to bet against my own projection either. I am wrong if North Dakota State's new backfield is as productive as the one it replaced.

picks.matchup: Sacramento State Hornets @ Eastern Michigan Eagles
picks.title: Sacramento State Hornets +9.5
picks.rationale: The model likes the points by 4.1 and the number has not moved off 9.5 in nine days, which normally means nobody has an opinion worth acting on. The research argues the other way, because Sacramento State is playing its first game as an FBS program, under a first year head coach, 2,300 miles from home, and a rating built on last season's FCS schedule is the least reliable number the model produces. That is a case for fading my own model rather than following it, and I am not confident enough in either direction to do more than log it. I am wrong about the caution if Sacramento State's roster travelled better than a reclassifying program usually does.

picks.matchup: Hawaii Rainbow Warriors @ Stanford Cardinal
picks.title: Hawaii Rainbow Warriors +4.5
picks.rationale: Stanford's starting quarterback has not played in a game in nearly 20 months. Davis Warren tore his right ACL in the ReliaQuest Bowl to end the 2024 season, sat out all of 2025, and was named the starter only in the final week of camp, in front of a head coach working his first game and two new coordinators. Hawai'i brings back Micah Alejado, who threw for 3,106 yards and 24 touchdowns last season, and a staff in its fifth year, so the side with the settled quarterback is the one getting points. The number opened at 5.5, traded to 3.5 on Wednesday and sits at 4.5 today, so this is the best price available since the move. I am wrong if Warren plays like the quarterback who started nine games for Michigan in 2024, and the risk is on my own side too, because Hawai'i has to replace 17 starters and the model only likes this by 1.9 points.

sources.claim: Stanford's starting quarterback has not played in a live game in nearly 20 months.
sources.quote: It has been nearly 20 months since Warren played in a game.

sources.claim: Warren was settled as the starter only in the final week of training camp.
sources.quote: Davis Warren was named Stanford's starting quarterback during the final week of training camp.

sources.claim: Hawai'i returns its quarterback, who carries preseason recognition into the opener.
sources.quote: Alejado enters his sophomore season as one of the nation's top quarterbacks, having been placed on six different preseason watch lists.

sources.claim: The main argument against this pick, that Hawai'i has almost no returning production outside quarterback.
sources.quote: UH will have to replace 17 starters across offense, defense and special teams.

picks.matchup: New Mexico State Aggies @ Florida State Seminoles
picks.title: New Mexico State Aggies +32.5
picks.title_full: New Mexico State Aggies +32.5, full game, -115
picks.rationale: Three points of model edge on the points, and Florida State is breaking in a new starting quarterback in Ashton Daniels, which is the usual way a heavy favourite stalls for a quarter and never gets the number back. The 115 price on a 32.5 hook eats most of a three point edge, and I found nothing researched that says the market is wrong, so this stays a shadow pick. Florida State reported no injuries to key players, which removes the one angle that would have moved it. I am wrong if Daniels is comfortable immediately and Florida State scores into the fourth quarter.

picks.matchup: Memphis Tigers @ UNLV Rebels
picks.title: UNLV Rebels -4.5
picks.rationale: Memphis has not named a starting quarterback three days before its first game under a first year head coach, with two transfers still splitting the job, while UNLV named Jackson Arnold and kept Dan Mullen and most of its staff. The model likes UNLV by 1.7 points and the number has come from 5.5 to 4.5, so the price is better than it was a week ago. What stops this from going live is that the move is money on Memphis rather than a stale line, and UNLV's own game notes say the Rebels return seven starters, so the continuity argument is thinner than it reads from the outside. I am wrong if Memphis settles on a quarterback who plays well immediately, which is exactly what the market appears to be betting on.

sources.claim: UNLV's continuity is weaker than the narrative suggests, with seven returning starters.
sources.quote: The Rebels return 32 lettermen (12 O/19 D/1 ST) and seven starters (3 on each side of the ball plus a PK).

picks.matchup: Memphis Tigers @ UNLV Rebels
picks.title: Over 56.5
picks.rationale: This is the largest gap on the board, 10.3 points, with the model at 66.8 against a market of 56.5 in a dome where weather cannot take a game under. UNLV's defense finished 89th nationally last season and the projection has both teams above 30 points. The reason it stays a shadow pick is that the total has moved down from 57.5 rather than up, and Memphis has no settled quarterback under a new staff, which is the ordinary way an opener stalls in the first quarter. I am wrong about calling it off if both offenses come out clean and the number was simply slow to catch up to two 30 point projections.

picks.matchup: Akron Zips @ Wake Forest Demon Deacons
picks.title: Under 48.5
picks.rationale: Wake Forest opens with Gio Lopez, a first year starter after transferring from North Carolina, and Akron's intended starter Reese Poffenbarger carries an unresolved eligibility question that may leave Braydon Roggow taking the snaps on a Thursday night. The model reads this total at 38.8 against a market number of 48.5. I did not open a page confirming the eligibility situation, so that claim is unconfirmed and the rating reflects that rather than assuming it. Two unproven quarterbacks in an opener is the same argument I am already making elsewhere on this card, which is a further reason to leave it as a shadow. I am wrong if Wake Forest scores at will against a Mid American defense and the game is decided by halftime.

picks.matchup: East Carolina Pirates @ Alabama Crimson Tide
picks.title: Under 52.5
picks.rationale: Alabama hands the offense to Keelon Russell for his first career start behind a run game that finished 125th nationally last season, and East Carolina arrives having replaced most of a 9-4 roster. The model reads the total at 43.4 against a market number of 52.5. I could not open the preview carrying East Carolina's returning production figure, so I am not citing it and I am not rating this on it. The reason this stays a shadow rather than a play is that a five star making a first start at home against a Group of Five defense is the softest possible landing spot, and Alabama alone can reach 40. I am wrong if Russell is efficient early and Alabama scores on its first four possessions.

picks.matchup: Coastal Carolina Chanticleers @ West Virginia Mountaineers
picks.title: Coastal Carolina +21.5
picks.rationale: West Virginia's own staff said on Wednesday that this roster has not played together, with Rich Rodriguez calling himself anxious because so many of his players have not run this system and defensive coordinator Zac Alley saying his worry is nerves rather than talent. A team laying 21.5 points has to execute cleanly for four quarters, and a portal-built roster in its first game together is the least likely version of West Virginia to do that. The ratings make this a 15.6 point game, so the market is asking for nearly a touchdown more than the projection and asking a brand new offense to deliver it at noon. What beats me is Coastal's quarterback: Thad Hudson left for N.C. State and the likely starter has 47 career pass attempts, so if the Chanticleers cannot move the ball at all the number stops mattering.

sources.claim: Rich Rodriguez says West Virginia's many new players have not played in his system
sources.quote: Even though a lot of them have played some college football, they haven't played in this system.

sources.claim: Coastal Carolina is opening under a first-year head coach
sources.quote: Coastal head coach Ryan Beard is in his first year after leaving behind Missouri State to guide the Sun Belt Conference member.

sources.claim: Coastal Carolina lost its starting quarterback to the portal and will start an inexperienced replacement
sources.quote: Coastal Carolina will have a new quarterback after Thad Hudson transferred to N.C. State.

picks.matchup: Liberty Flames @ James Madison Dukes
picks.title: Over 50.5
picks.rationale: The consensus total on this game is 52.5 and FanDuel is at 50.5, so the Over is available 2 points below where the rest of the market has it. James Madison turned over most of the roster that reached the playoff and is leaning on transfers to carry a new offense, which is the profile of a team that scores in bursts and gives up more than its rating suggests while everything is still being installed. Liberty's defensive front is experienced but undersized, and the projection has this game at 60 points against a market number in the low 50s. The mechanism that beats me is the new coordinator's run game, because an offense that ripped teams apart on the ground also shortens the game and takes possessions off the board.

sources.claim: James Madison is relying almost entirely on transfers while Liberty returns its own veterans
sources.quote: Liberty is a team full of its own veterans with a few transfers sprinkled in, and James Madison will be almost fully reliant on the transfers to shine right away.

sources.claim: Liberty's defensive front is not big or talented enough to hold down the new James Madison offense
sources.quote: The Liberty defensive front is experienced, but it's not all that big and not quite talented enough to handle what the new-look JMU offense is about to bring.

picks.matchup: East Carolina Pirates @ Alabama Crimson Tide
picks.title: East Carolina +27.5
picks.rationale: Alabama is handing its offense to Keelon Russell, who won the job in camp and has almost no game experience, and asking him to cover 27.5 points in a 12 p.m. kickoff in his first start. East Carolina is not a typical guarantee-game opponent either, with a defense described as good enough to be a problem and a portal-rebuilt offense that should move the ball. The ratings make this a 22.8 point game, so the market is charging nearly 5 points more than the projection for a team whose passing game has never taken a live snap together. The way this goes wrong is the Alabama defense simply ending it early, which is the explicit expectation even if the offense is slow to start.

sources.claim: Keelon Russell is an unproven first-year starter who won the Alabama job in fall camp
sources.quote: He won a tough quarterback battle with Austin Mack to be Bama's next big star, and he's got the receiving corps to look magnificent right out of the gate.

sources.claim: East Carolina's defense and rebuilt offense make it a live underdog rather than a walkover
sources.quote: The defense is good enough to be a problem, and all the new parts from the transfer portal should keep things going on the offensive side.

picks.matchup: Oregon State Beavers @ Houston Cougars
picks.title: Oregon State +20.5
picks.rationale: The ratings like Oregon State getting 20.5 and make this a 16.4 point game, but the research runs the other way hard enough that I am rating this below the rest of the card rather than trusting the gap. Oregon State is 3-16 over its last 19 games and did not win a road game last season, while Houston went 10-3 and won all six of its road games. The 4 point disagreement is real but it is built on carryover ratings that still have some 2024 Oregon State in them. I am keeping this on the board because the number is genuinely large and Houston has to prove the offense travels to a noon kickoff, but I would not defend it above a 7.

sources.claim: Oregon State has been one of the worst teams in the country over the last two seasons
sources.quote: Oregon State is just 3-16 over its last 19 games.

picks.matchup: Marshall Thundering Herd @ Penn State Nittany Lions
picks.title: Over 52.5
picks.rationale: This is the largest total gap on the board at 12.3 points, with the model at 64.8 against a market number of 52.5, and unlike most of the board the research does not cut against it. Penn State starts Rocco Becht, who made 39 starts at Iowa State, and Marshall returns Carlos Del Rio-Wilson, the Sun Belt preseason offensive player of the year who ran for 660 yards last season. What holds it down is that Matt Campbell is in his first game at Penn State and new staffs open conservatively, and a 24.5 point favorite that leads comfortably will shorten the second half. I am wrong if Penn State empties the bench up 28 and the fourth quarter is a running clock.

picks.matchup: Marshall Thundering Herd @ Penn State Nittany Lions
picks.title: Under 52.5
picks.rationale: This is the one game on the card where I am taking the opposite side of the ratings model, which projects 64.8 points and is running on last year's Penn State, not Matt Campbell's. Campbell brought Rocco Becht and a load of former Cyclones with him, and the described plan is a balanced offense without many crazy ideas, which is a description of a team that runs the ball with a big lead rather than one that hangs 45. Marshall has a capable quarterback in Carlos Del Rio-Wilson but is a 24.5 point underdog, so the realistic path to 53 points requires Penn State to keep throwing late. If Campbell decides his new offense needs the live reps and leaves the starters in, this goes over without much drama.

sources.claim: Penn State's new offense under Matt Campbell is expected to be balanced and conservative
sources.quote: Former Iowa State quarterback Rocco Becht will be fine right away, the offense will be balanced, and there won't be too many crazy ideas happening on that side of the ball.

sources.claim: Marshall has a returning starting quarterback capable of scoring, which is the risk to the Under
sources.quote: Marshall has a good quarterback in Carlos Del Rio-Wilson, who showed last year what he could do when getting time to work.

picks.matchup: Wyoming Cowboys @ Colorado State Rams
picks.title: Under 46.5
picks.rationale: Neither team has a quarterback the other has seen. Colorado State is in year one under Jim Mora, who has kept the job open between transfers Hauss Hejny and K'saan Farrar since March and has said the decision does not have to be made until kickoff, and Wyoming answers with Tyler Hughes, who arrived from William and Mary in January and has never taken an FBS snap. The blended ratings put this game at 35.2 points against a market number of 46.5, the second largest total gap on the board, and both offenses grade in the mid teens while both defenses return more of their work. I am paying -118 on a number that already fell from 47.5 to 46.5, so the cheap side of this move is gone and I am agreeing with money rather than beating it, which is what holds this at 8.0 instead of higher. Hughes ran for 670 yards at William and Mary, and a mobile quarterback who plays clean in his first FBS start is the version of this game that goes over.

sources.claim: Colorado State's two quarterback candidates are both transfers who have been competing for the job since March, with no starter named.
sources.quote: Hejny and Farrar, the transfer QBs, have been competing since March for the starting position during the kickoff game Sept. 5 against Wyoming.

sources.claim: Mora has said he does not have to name a starting quarterback until kickoff of the opener.
sources.quote: We don't have to make that decision until kickoff before the first game

sources.claim: Colorado State is installing a new system under a first year head coach.
sources.quote: Colorado State is entering its first season under head coach Jim Mora.

sources.claim: Wyoming's starting quarterback is an FCS transfer who arrived in January and has never played an FBS snap.
sources.quote: Hughes, who last season at William and Mary, threw for 2,330 yards and 20 touchdowns, arrived in Laramie in January via the NCAA Transfer Portal.

picks.matchup: Florida International Panthers @ South Florida Bulls
picks.title: Over 51.5
picks.rationale: The model reads this total at 63.1 against a market number of 51.5, an 11.6 point gap that survives the calibration adjustment. I did no research on either roster beyond the ratings, so this is logged as a pure model candidate and rated accordingly rather than talked up to the card. It is here because the grader needs the model's raw total edges tracked to find out whether they are worth anything, and September totals off carryover ratings are exactly the cell with no data in it. I am wrong if either offense is worse than last season's rating, which is the common case for a model running on carryover numbers.
